summary: Layer 4 lists its scripts by hand and omits two tracked unit tests. Neither test-consensus-synthesizer-regressions.py nor test-native-eval-fixture-setup.py appears in the manifest, so run-all.py and the CI suite never run them. test-unit-layout.py does not check roster completeness. No in-flight branch adds them.
proposed_fix: Add both tests to layer 4 in suite-manifest.json, and add a manifest-completeness check (every unit/test-*.py is listed) to test-unit-layout.py.

summary: Agent roster, sandbox and profile facts are restated by hand in five places (CODEX_SANDBOX_POLICY, _check_profile, two capability EXCLUSIONS pairs, CC_ONLY_AGENTS) although AGENT_INVENTORY already holds them. The two CC exclusion sets already differ. PR 851 adds one role and must edit six lists.
proposed_fix: Derive the sandbox, profile, Claude-only, Codex-only and exemption sets from AGENT_INVENTORY (or one shared test helper) and delete the hand-kept copies.

summary: Three hand-kept skill rosters exist and none is compared to the skills/ and codex-skills/ directories. A new skill added to both trees gets parity and pointer checks only, and skips the frontmatter, name and description checks in test_skills and test_codex_skills.
proposed_fix: Assert each roster equals the discovered directory set, or iterate the discovered set with per-skill policy tables.

summary: The lifecycle validator reimplements the structureVersion gate, frontmatter scalar parsing and spec-ID normalization twice (orphan and stale variants) instead of using the runner helpers (_spec_index_is_gated, _spec_index_normalize). The copies differ in quote stripping and digit checks, so the lint and the generator can disagree.
proposed_fix: Import the runner functions (or extract one shared module) and delete the local copies.

summary: One file named for spec lifecycle bundles unrelated contracts: zero shell scripts in the plugin, roadmap and spec templates, .specify extension integrity, .gitattributes scope, MOC orphan and stale lints (with a CLI mode), spec-index determinism, and the shipped-prose interpreter rule. A failure names the file, not the concern.
proposed_fix: Split by concern (plugin payload hygiene, spec templates and extensions, MOC lint, spec-index helper contract) and update the manifest entries.

summary: A layer 1 structural validator pins layer 3 eval JSON content by numeric eval id (106, 18, 14, 19, 15, 4). The speckit-coach eval 4 assertions also sit inside _check_autopilot_skill, a Codex autopilot helper. PR 851 already had to rewrite them.
proposed_fix: Move eval-content pins next to the eval fixtures (layer 3 unit tests) and key them by stable case id.

summary: run-all.py exports TESTS_DIR, PLUGIN_ROOT and PROJECT_ROOT to children, but nothing under tests, scripts or the plugin reads them. Its docstring (lines 4 and 17) and run-layer-scripts.py:69 cite the retired run-all.sh. The two dispatchers also build different child environments.
proposed_fix: Drop the unused variables, remove run-all.sh references, and share one child-environment helper.

summary: The install_specs_read_guard docstring lists opt-out suites that no longer exist (validate-moc-orphan, validate-moc-stale-index, validate-agent-instructions) and names test-artifact-gallery, which does not pass allow_live_specs. The lifecycle validator prints warnings naming the retired scripts.
proposed_fix: Update the docstring to the real opt-out set (privacy scan, spec lifecycle, agent contracts) and fix the warning text.

summary: Every committed spec-index fixture carries the legacy sentinel spelling (regenerated by generate-spec-index.sh) and prose naming the retired shell script, while templates and the runner emit generate-spec-index. The canonical spelling is exercised only by a string replace in one test, and the fixtures README does not say the spelling is deliberate.
proposed_fix: State in the fixtures README that the .sh spelling is the legacy-migration input, and add a canonical-spelling fixture tree.

ripwire_command: ripwire . --exemplar="parse toml developer_instructions and yaml frontmatter field"
summary: Frontmatter field and TOML instruction extractors are copied per validator (_field twice at 0.97 clone similarity, _extract_developer_instructions and _toml_prose) although lib/structural_helpers.py exists. The copies differ: layer 1 strips quotes, layer 5 does not.
proposed_fix: Move the extractors into structural_helpers.py and import them.

summary: build_suite runs a hand-listed TEST_METHOD_ORDER, so a test method added to ValidateToolScoping and not listed never runs, and the suite still passes.
proposed_fix: Discover test_* methods and keep an explicit order only for the one test that mutates module state, or assert the list equals the discovered set.

summary: validate-agent-contracts.py also owns the AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and Copilot wrapper and size-budget checks (repo instruction hygiene), which is a different concern from plugin agent definitions.
proposed_fix: Move collect_errors and its constants to their own validator.

summary: APPROVED_EQUIVALENTS is an empty frozenset and _approved_equivalent can never return true, so the escape hatch is dead code that reads as a live policy.
proposed_fix: Delete the constant and the helper, or record a real equivalent.
